_comment: VOLUME background gate, calibrated specifically for T (T-Bank) — same grid as the root data/params/rsi_pullback/cal_volume.json. Forces UseVolume=1 and sweeps how much busier than usual the tape must be (24 evaluations). VolMult is the ratio against the bar's OWN half-hour slot averaged over the last VolBaseDays completed weekday days: 1.1 means 'barely above normal', 2.0 demands a clear burst. VolBaseDays trades adaptivity for stability — 3 days follow a regime change quickly, 14 days (matching the strategy's own default) shrug off one freak session but push Lookback to 1008 bars, making this the slowest file to run. VolLookbackBars stays fixed at 3 by strategy definition. This gate is the single largest cut on trade count, so read cal_screen.json's numbers before trusting any ranking here. Run: go run ./cmd/backtest -ticker T -strategy rsi_pullback -interval Minutes30 -calibrate data/params/rsi_pullback/t/cal_volume.json -out ./reports/T_volume -months 24 -min-trades 20 -test-months 6 -metric profit_factor.
